scope: Author-side diagnostic; no model or hyperparameter changes, no clipping or target replacements. Independent review is a separate gate.
support_definition: Exact nonzero nodal truth, without a newly selected numerical threshold. Source derivation/projection is defined in the frozen cache. Nodal peaks do not establish original element or integration-point extrema.
source_field_definition: Displacement is nodal solver output. VM upper/lower is the in-plane invariant sqrt(sxx^2-sxx*syy+syy^2+3*sxy^2) of each local shell tensor, projected by initial shell area. EPSP upper/lower is scalar solver output projected by the same rule. These are surface-specific nodal averaged fields, not raw-cell hotspots or through-thickness-averaged solver VONM.
source_strain_note: EPSP is equivalent plastic strain. Total strain was not exported in these original 131 cases and is absent here.

prediction.difference_definition: np.diff(time) in float64 of the stored float32 endpoints; exact negative signs retained without tolerance or clipping
prediction.interpretation: A negative increment is observed history inconsistency, not an automatic error verdict. Endpoint ULP ratios describe floating-point resolution; no success threshold was chosen. This diagnostic applies to accumulated EPSP, not total strain Frobenius or signed principal strains.

policy: Raw ANIM status (official VTK EROSION_STATUS), uint8 [T,E], is preserved. Fixed-initial-topology scalar projection includes every real shell, including status 0; it does not remove stale/eroded output or claim damage validity. Per-frame status-zero counts are reported.
upper_lower_semantics: Stress/EPSP upper/lower outermost integration points; total strain upper/lower extrapolated outer shell surfaces; layer_1..5 also preserved.
